item_short_desc: Rothco's Adjustable Front Snap Holster is designed to fit 4” and 5” autos, including Beretta 92, Colt, and Glock models. Featuring a vinyl-lined interior to protect your firearm and an adjustable snap closure for secure, easy access, this holster is perfect for tactical or everyday use.
